sourceState.identity: dirty working-tree source state identified by revision plus contentDigest; this does not prove which source built the loaded artifacts

contentDigest.framing: sorted git pathname bytes framed by uint64-be length, then pathname, one-byte presence, and for present files uint64-be content length plus content

sorted package-relative UTF-8 path framed by uint64-be length, then path, uint64-be content length, then content; native file names take part in the digest but are not listed because they carry platform tags

buildProvenance.statement: source-state and loaded-artifact digests are recorded independently; the harness does not claim an attested build link between them

method.scheduling: one request in flight per subject; every round runs each subject once in a deterministic order reshuffled from `orderSeed`, so positions and predecessors both vary; a cyclic rotation would pin every subject behind the same neighbour in every round
method.auditData: raw samplesMs and per-round subject order are retained by default; --no-samples is an explicit local-only size optimization
method.payloadBytes: server-side `count -8!table` for the fixture table: a logical payload size shared by all subjects, not observed wire bytes
method.throughput: payloadBytes divided by the median duration
method.memory: process-wide RSS delta around retained decoded frames with forced GC at both snapshots; a noisy diagnostic, not a library footprint
method.preflight: one subprocess per subject flushes JSON stage boundaries before operations and result events after completed checks, so an interpreter abort is pinned to the operation that killed it without ending the comparison
method.scalarComparability: value-exact latency floor; a subject that cannot return the exact value is listed in `unsupported` instead of being ranked
method.readComparability: every subject that can decode the table is ranked because the server sends identical bytes to all of them; timed validation proves the decoded row count, not table content fidelity. Exact int64 and nanosecond atom probes are recorded in `fidelity`; `roundTripStates` separately distinguishes identical, differs, resized, and unverified decode-then-encode outcomes without assigning an encoder failure to the decoder
method.sendComparability: sends are compared only for subjects whose decoded frame re-encodes to a q-identical value of the same canonical size; others are listed in `unsupported` with no samples, throughput, or ratio
method.untimedCorrectnessChecks: int64 and nanosecond-timestamp exactness are reported by the preflight, not timed: timing a wrong decode against a right one would compare different work

excludedSubjects.pykx: the licence covering PyKX's bundled q runtime forbids making performance comparisons available to third parties
excludedSubjects.qpython and qpython3: both dereference numpy aliases removed in numpy 2, so they require numpy<1.20 and Python<=3.9; qconnect is the maintained fork measured here
excludedSubjects.pyq: embeds Python inside q rather than acting as a client
